name: Fidato — Reservation confirmed (email + Drive + Meta Cloud WhatsApp)

nodes.name: Save PDF to Drive
nodes.notes: The Drive copy stays PRIVATE. Meta gets the file by upload, not by URL, so nothing here needs to be link-readable.

nodes.name: Upload PDF to Meta
nodes.notes:
⚠️ THIS is why Meta Cloud beats a URL header. The file is uploaded straight to Meta and referenced by id, so the voucher is never publicly reachable — no Drive sharing, no public bucket, nothing for a stranger to fetch. Returns { id }, valid for 30 days.

Set META_PHONE_NUMBER_ID in n8n → Settings → Variables, or paste the number id into the URL.

nodes.name: Send WhatsApp template
nodes.notes:
⚠️ `name` and `language.code` must match the APPROVED template exactly. A template approved as en_US will fail as 'en' with an error that does not say so.

The two static buttons need no component — only buttons carrying a variable do.
